sehemu: Part I: Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance
jina: Powers of the Commission and procedure for its activities
maudhui: (1) Without prejudice to the other provisions of this Article, Parliament may enact a law under this Chapter prescribing the powers of the Commission, procedures for conducting its business and legal immunities for Commissioners and employees of the Commission to enable them to perform their functions without legal impediment. (2) For purposes of performing its functions, the Commission shall not inquire into: (a) any matter pending before a court or other judicial body; (b) any matter concerning relations or cooperation between the Government and the government of a foreign country or an international organization; (c) any matter concerning the President's power of pardon; or (d) any other matter prescribed by law. (3) In every financial year the Commission shall prepare and submit to the Minister responsible for human rights a report concerning: (a) the activities of the Commission during the preceding year; and (b) the state of implementation and protection of human rights in the United Republic, and the Minister shall lay every report submitted to him before Parliament as soon as practicable after receiving it. (4) Subarticle (3) shall not be construed as preventing the Commission from submitting any other report to any other person or authority.
